statBlock.name: Blue Slaad
statBlock.description: A blue slaad’s hooked claws carry chaos phage, a disease that can turn a humanoid into a slaad.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. A humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it contracts chaos phage.
Chaos Phage. The infected target cannot regain HP and loses 10 (3d6) from its HP maximum every 24 hours. At a maximum of 0 HP, it immediately becomes a red slaad, or a green slaad if it can cast spells of 3rd level or higher. Only Wish reverses that transformation.

ruleNotes: Control gems are the optional rule on p. 274. The base profile uses no gem trait.
Chaos phage is a disease. The block gives no recurring save or special cure before transformation.

statBlock.name: Death Slaad
statBlock.description: Death slaadi lead red and blue slaadi on raids into other planes. Necrotic energy suffuses their weapons and natural attacks.

sections.Senses: Blindsight and darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
2/day each. Fear, Fireball, Fly, Tongues.
1/day each. Cloudkill, Plane Shift.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw or Greatsword attacks.
Bite (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Claw (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

ruleNotes: Control gems are the optional rule on p. 274. The base profile uses no gem trait.
The printed Multiattack includes a Bite, which is available only in slaad form. In humanoid form, use the listed individual weapon attack unless another printed Multiattack option is available.

statBlock.name: Gray Slaad
statBlock.description: A gray slaad can pass for a humanoid and use illusion, flight, and planar travel to choose its fights.

sections.Senses: Blindsight and darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The slaad’s weapon attacks count as magical.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 14. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Invisibility (self only), Mage Hand, Major Image.
2/day each. Fear, Fly, Fireball, Tongues.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw or Greatsword attacks.
Bite (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

ruleNotes: Use the separately indexed Gray Slaad (control gem variant) for the optional trait on p. 274.
The printed Multiattack includes a Bite, which is available only in slaad form. In humanoid form, use the listed individual weapon attack unless another printed Multiattack option is available.

statBlock.name: Green Slaad
statBlock.description: A green slaad can pass for a humanoid and strike with a staff or throw fire from a distance.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the slaad can take the form of a Small or Medium humanoid or return to its true form. Only its size changes in its statistics. Its equipment keeps its own form. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, spell save DC 12. No material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand.
2/day each. Fear, Invisibility (self only).
1/day. Fireball.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw or Staff attacks, or use Hurl Flame twice instead.
Bite (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw (slaad form only). Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage. The flames ignite flammable objects that are not worn or carried.

ruleNotes: Control gems are the optional rule on p. 274. The base profile uses no gem trait.
The printed Multiattack includes a Bite, which is available only in slaad form. In humanoid form, use the listed individual weapon attack unless another printed Multiattack option is available.

statBlock.name: Red Slaad
statBlock.description: A red slaad can leave an egg in a humanoid it claws. A growing tadpole uses that creature as its host.

sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the slaad regains 10 HP if it has at least 1 HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. A humanoid hit by the claw makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it contracts a disease by receiving a slaad egg.
Slaad Egg. A humanoid can carry only one egg to term at a time. The egg migrates to its chest and becomes a tadpole over three months. For the last 24 hours, halve the host’s speed and give it disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks and saves. The tadpole emerges over one round and kills the host. Curing the disease before emergence destroys the unborn tadpole.

ruleNotes: Control gems are the optional rule on p. 274. The base profile uses no gem trait.

statBlock.name: Slaad Tadpole
statBlock.description: A newly emerged tadpole feeds on the remains of its host and then seeks other prey.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The slaad has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Maturation: Within 2d12 hours of emerging, the tadpole matures into a blue slaad. If its host could cast spells of 3rd level or higher, it matures into a green slaad instead.

statBlock.name: Bone Naga
statBlock.description: A yuan-ti ritual turns a living naga into a skeletal servant and stops it from returning to life. The servant retains some of the spells it knew in life.

sections.Traits: Immortal Nature. Nagas have no need for air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Spellcasting: 5th-level spellcaster, spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks. Its spells require only verbal components. Select one prepared list according to its former kind.
sections.Guardian naga spell list:
Wisdom (cleric).
Cantrips at will. Mending, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Shield of Faith.
2nd level (3 slots). Calm Emotions, Hold Person.
3rd level (2 slots). Bestow Curse.
sections.Spirit naga spell list:
Intelligence (wizard).
Cantrips at will. Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots). Charm Person, Sleep.
2nd level (3 slots). Detect Thoughts, Hold Person.
3rd level (2 slots). Lightning Bolt.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

ruleNotes: The guardian and spirit prepared lists are alternatives in this printed block. Their separately indexed entries remain distinct.
